text:
Dear Ms Dowd,

Following today's news, I am pleased to confirm that TransVale Carriers can supply 15 drivers with their own trucks at 290 € per day.

Please note that this offer is valid until 30/11/2026. We would be grateful to receive your decision by that date, so that we can reserve the capacity for Kestrel Haulage Ltd without delay.

I have copied Mr Orlin for his information. Should you wish to discuss the terms, I remain at your disposal.

Kind regards,

Ivana Koss
Sales Manager
TransVale Carriers
